title: Angle Health Ranks Among Top 100 of Fastest-Growing Companies in North America on the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™
summary: Attributes 925% Revenue Growth to Growing Demand for Affordable Healthcare Among Small Bus
body_markdown:
Angle Health today announced that it ranked number 78 on the Deloitte Technology Fast500™, a ranking of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America, now in its 32nd year. Angle Health grew 925% during 2022 to 2025.


Angle Health’s growth reflects the growing demand among small businesses for affordable healthcare and the company’s ability to deliver some of the most stable renewal rates in market, at a time when employers are facing some of the steepest rate increases in decades.


“The 2026 rankings demonstrate that established momentum and breakthrough growth can drive sustained market leadership,” said Justin Yahr, Audit & Assurance partner and National Emerging Growth Company leader, Deloitte & Touche LLP. “Nearly 70% of this year’s award winners returned as repeat honorees, reflecting the power of disciplined and sustained execution. More than 30% made the list for the first time, illustrating how quickly new players are shaping their respective sectors. Furthermore, private companies represented almost 80% of the list, a clear indication that the agility and strategic focus of private enterprises remain essential to scaling in competitive markets.”


**About the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500**


Now in its 32nd year, the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 provides a ranking of the fastest-growing tech companies — both public and private — in North America. Technology Fast 500 award winners are selected based on percentage fiscal year revenue growth from 2022 to 2025.


In order to be eligible for Technology Fast 500 recognition, companies must own proprietary intellectual property or proprietary technology that significantly contributes to the company’s operating revenues. Companies must have base-year (fiscal year 2022) operating revenues of at least US $50,000, and current-year operating revenues of at least US $5 million, with a growth rate of 50% or greater. Additionally, companies must be in business for a minimum of four years and be headquartered within North America (United States and Canada).


**About Angle Health**


Angle Health connects thousands of employers and their employees to transparent, affordable healthcare. Through its AI-native healthcare benefits platform capable of end-to-end health plan administration, Angle Health enables businesses of any size to offer custom, integrated benefits and personalized healthcare experiences. The Angle Benefit Builder and Quote-to-Card platforms enable brokers to generate firm underwritten quotes in minutes with just a census and implement groups in real-time. To learn more, visit www.anglehealth.com.
